FOR THE FINAL COMMIT (item 15):
- One file OUTSIDE the plan's Digest changed and must be staged: src/routes/+layout.svelte. Adding the four new routes pushed the `Path` union from $app/types past TypeScript's 25-member limit for checking a union argument against `resolve()`'s union of tuples, so `resolve(localizeHref(page.url.pathname, { locale }) as Path)` in the hidden locale-links div stopped compiling (svelte-check error in a file I hadn't touched). Fixed by `href={localizeHref(page.url.pathname, { locale }) as ResolvedPathname}` (import type ResolvedPathname from '$app/types') with a comment that the current pathname already includes the base path. Same output (no base path is configured; resolve() would have double-prefixed one anyway), and svelte/no-navigation-without-resolve accepts ResolvedPathname-typed values.
- Real change set = git diff --numstat (15 files incl. src/routes/+layout.svelte) + 19 untracked files under drizzle/, e2e/, src/ — exactly the Digest list plus src/routes/+layout.svelte.

IMPLEMENTATION NOTES / DEVIATIONS:
- Message keys and strings are verbatim from plan item 8 (39 added keys). No hard-coded UI strings.
- ScoreForm renders `{@render children?.()}` first inside the form, then the two labels and the submit button, keeping the admin markup (form.result, score1/score2, aria-label 'Score of {name}', btn small primary). The admin list's inline form and its .result CSS are gone; the per-stage list and its li[data-testid=match-{id}] rows are otherwise unchanged.
- Public matches page: 'Your matches' rows have no data-testid (avoids duplicate ids); stage/group lists use data-testid=match-{id} and class:mine. Groups with no numbered match are skipped.
- Match room: the result card is hidden for spectators of a ready match nobody reported yet (it would be an empty card). Organizer tools card shows when canSet, or when the viewer is an organizer and help is requested (room_help_clear). The 'Report a different score' toggle is a button with aria-expanded.
- Room actions use a local act(event, run) helper plus parse(schema, value) that turns Zod issues into ServiceError, so Zod and service errors both become fail(400, { error }). report/help/message use requireUser + loadTournament; override/clear/clearHelp use requireTournamentAdmin. The message action's organizer flag = isMember && locals.trusted.
- Admin queue: queue_open link is shown on every queue item (the plan's wording was ambiguous); the clearHelp form only when help is requested.
- live.ts listen() calls invalidateAll() on every 'open'. Pages pass a $derived string URL to listen() inside $effect, so data reloads don't reconnect; a pathname change does.
- docs/PLAN.md: 'M6 ✅' row and '## Implementation notes (M6)' after the M5 notes. No README change.
